$comment: The one reviewed record of how large the component corpus is. Every count that used to be a literal in tooling/, distribution/*.schema.json, tooling/specs/ and .github/workflows/ is read from here or derived from the inventory; nothing else restates a number. A content migration bumps this file and nothing else. Recompute with: node tooling/component-inventory-counts.mjs --print

floatingDispositions.$comment: skill-packaged-candidate and skill-blocked-candidate move when a skill is promoted from blocked to packaged without the corpus changing size, so they are not sealed individually. Their sum with skill-legacy-repository-only is sealed as skillDispositionCount instead.
